clues.it: LA VITTIMA. Era da sola con l'assassino.
clues.en: The Victim. Was alone with the murderer.

clues.it: Rosa era nella 2ª riga, accanto a una pozza e in una stanza diversa da Sergio.
clues.en: Rosa was in the 2nd row, beside a puddle and in a different room from Sergio.

clues.it: Vito era nella 3ª riga, accanto a una sedia e a ovest di Ugo.
clues.en: Vito was in the 3rd row, beside a chair and west of Ugo.

clues.it: Dario era nella 10ª colonna, nella 4ª riga, a nord di Tea e sulla Spiaggia.
clues.en: Dario was in the 10th column, in the 4th row, north of Tea and on the Beach.

clues.it: Paolo era nella 1ª colonna, nella 5ª riga e a nord di Tea.
clues.en: Paolo was in the 1st column, in the 5th row and north of Tea.

clues.it: Tea era nella 6ª riga, esattamente una riga a nord di Marta e in Cabina.
clues.en: Tea was in the 6th row, exactly one row north of Marta and in the Cabin.

clues.it: Marta era nella 5ª colonna e in una stanza diversa da Tea.
clues.en: Marta was in the 5th column and in a different room from Tea.

clues.it: Ugo era nella 8ª riga, accanto a una lanterna e a nord di Irene.
clues.en: Ugo was in the 8th row, beside a lantern and north of Irene.

clues.it: Carla era accanto a una cuccetta, a ovest di Anna e in Plancia.
clues.en: Carla was beside a bunk, west of Anna and on the Bridge.

clues.it: Anna era l'unica seduta su una sedia, ma non era accanto a una cassa.
clues.en: Anna was the only one sitting on a chair, but was not beside a crate.

clues.it: Bruno era nella 2ª colonna, accanto a una pianta e in Plancia.
clues.en: Bruno was in the 2nd column, beside a plant and on the Bridge.

clues.it: Nino era l'unica persona su una rete e in una stanza diversa da Dario.
clues.en: Nino was the only person on a net and in a different room from Dario.

clues.it: Sergio era nella 4ª colonna, nella 13ª riga e a ovest di Dario.
clues.en: Sergio was in the 4th column, in the 13th row and west of Dario.

clues.it: Irene era nella 13ª colonna e accanto a un'ancora o a un salvagente.
clues.en: Irene was in the 13th column and beside an anchor or a life ring.

clues.it: Olga era in Cambusa, ma non era accanto a una pianta.
clues.en: Olga was in the Galley, but was not beside a plant.

clues.it: Fabio era nella 9ª colonna, nella 16ª riga e in Cambusa.
clues.en: Fabio was in the 9th column, in the 16th row and in the Galley.

steps.it: L'indizio di Rosa lascia una sola casella libera: riga 2ª, colonna 16ª.
steps.en: Rosa's own clue leaves a single free square: row 2nd, column 16th.

steps.en: Dario's own clue leaves a single free square: row 4th, column 10th.

steps.it: Incrociando l'indizio di Marta con quelli già usati resta una sola casella: riga 7ª, colonna 5ª.
steps.en: Cross-checking Marta's clue with the ones already used leaves a single square: row 7th, column 5th.

steps.it: Bruno può stare solo nella 2ª colonna: escludendola, a Vito resta una sola casella: riga 3ª, colonna 12ª.
steps.en: Bruno can only be in the 2nd column: ruling it out leaves Vito a single square: row 3rd, column 12th.

steps.it: Sergio può stare solo nella 4ª colonna: escludendola, a Carla resta una sola casella: riga 9ª, colonna 3ª.
steps.en: Sergio can only be in the 4th column: ruling it out leaves Carla a single square: row 9th, column 3rd.

steps.en: Irene can only be in the 14th row: ruling it out leaves Nino a single square: row 12th, column 11th.

steps.en: Anna can only be in the 10th row: ruling it out leaves Olga a single square: row 15th, column 7th.

steps.it: L'indizio generale «2 accanto a uno scaffale» non torna senza Giada: deve stare in riga 1ª, colonna 6ª.
steps.en: The general clue “2 beside a shelf” cannot add up without Giada: they must be at row 1st, column 6th.
